ownerAttribution.author: Dr Joel Penner, OMD, LAc
ownerAttribution.note: Site remains online as a free reference after Dr Penner's passing (Jan 2020). Clinic reports written permission from the owner/estate before any corpus ingest.

siteSummary: Large classical Chinese medicine reference: acupuncture points, individual herbs, herb formulas, and medical-condition / syndrome pages. Legacy static HTML with accordion section headings.

contentTypes.label: Herb formulas
contentTypes.note: Includes many numbered condition-specific formula variants (e.g. Acne1–Acne6).

technicalNotes: Static HTML; many accordion panels via JavaScript IDs (p7ABt*).
URL encoding quirks (spaces in 'Herb Formulas copy/', mixed absolute/relative links).
Duplicate/near-duplicate condition links with leading ../ or /.
Not a modern CMS — discovery must start from indexes, not a sitemap.
clinicUsePolicy: Do not republish American Dragon HTML verbatim on patient pages.
Ingest into a private normalized corpus first (permission-gated fetch).
Publish clinic-voice education notes that cite American Dragon as a source where appropriate.
Keep MSK patient acupuncture track separate from deep TCM reference browse.
